articles.title: Nationwide ground stop lifted after hours of travel chaos
articles.description: The FAA lifted a rare nationwide ground stop on Friday evening after a communications outage at air traffic control centers. More than 6,600 flights were cancelled and 8,600 delayed, according to FlightRadar24. Officials said travel should recover by the end of the weekend.

articles.title: US flights grounded nationwide after air traffic control outage
articles.description: All departures across the United States were halted for more than four hours on Friday after a communications failure hit air traffic control centres. Thousands of flights were cancelled or delayed. The transport secretary blamed ageing technology.

articles.title: FAA ground stop halts all US departures; Duffy blames outdated air traffic technology
articles.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said overloaded routers and aging air traffic control systems caused the nationwide ground stop. Some controllers questioned the explanation. Airspace reopened at about 8:15 p.m. Eastern.

articles.title: Nationwide Ground Stop Snarls Air Travel Across the U.S.
articles.description: A communications failure at air traffic control centers forced the F.A.A. to halt departures nationwide for more than four hours, stranding travelers at airports across the country.

articles.title: Some US flights resume after hours-long ground stop

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns. Here's who is running the company now

articles.title: Nvidia names CFO Colette Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
articles.description: Nvidia said Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive and from the board, effective immediately. Chief financial officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor. Shares ended the week down about 13%.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns. Here's who is running the company now
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang resigns amid spy affair scandal
articles.description: Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive of Nvidia after admitting an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The chip giant's finance chief Colette Kress will lead the company on an interim basis.

stories.title: Pope Leo makes emotional return to former diocese in Peru

articles.title: Pope Leo makes emotional return to former diocese in Peru
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV returned to Chiclayo, where he served as bishop for eight years. Vatican News said about half a million people attended an open-air Mass. He told the crowd it was a joy to be home.

articles.title: Pope Leo Returns to Peru, the Country That Shaped Him
articles.description: Tens of thousands gathered in Chiclayo as the first American pope returned to the diocese he once led, the first papal visit to Peru since 2018.

stories.title: Tanker crashes into docked river cruise ship in New Orleans

articles.title: Tanker crashes into docked river cruise ship in New Orleans
articles.description: A tanker lost steering on the Mississippi River and struck a docked river cruise ship in New Orleans. All passengers were rescued, and 32 people were taken to hospitals with non-critical injuries. The NTSB has opened an investigation.

articles.title: Cruise passengers rescued after tanker slams into ship on Mississippi River
articles.description: Dozens of people were hurt when a tanker crashed into a river cruise ship docked in New Orleans. City officials said no one died and all passengers were rescued.

stories.title: Bessent clashes with Lutnick over chip exports to China

articles.title: Bessent clashes with Lutnick over chip exports to China
articles.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent pressed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over why Nvidia customer Megaspeed had not been added to the entity list. Lutnick reportedly worried the move would escalate trade tensions with Beijing.

articles.title: Bessent says Commerce controls decision on blacklisting Nvidia customer Megaspeed
articles.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said several agencies had backed adding Megaspeed to the entity list for months. He said the decision rests with the Commerce Department. Megaspeed denies diverting chips to China.

stories.title: Stocks End Their Losing Streak as Investors Look Past Nvidia Turmoil

articles.title: Stocks End Their Losing Streak as Investors Look Past Nvidia Turmoil
articles.description: The S&P 500 rose 2.5% for the week, snapping four straight weekly declines. All 11 sectors finished higher. Investors are now focused on Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's IPO next week.

stories.title: Nasdaq slips as Nvidia sells off, but stocks post their best week since August

articles.title: Nasdaq slips as Nvidia sells off, but stocks post their best week since August
articles.description: The Nasdaq fell 0.91% on Friday and the S&P 500 slid 0.4%, while the Dow edged up 0.1%. Even so, all three major averages notched their best weekly performance since early August. Investors rotated into other tech names such as Apple, AMD and Broadcom.

stories.title: Anthropic Lines Up Meetings With Investors Ahead of Blockbuster Listing
entities: lines up meetings with investors ahead

articles.title: Anthropic Lines Up Meetings With Investors Ahead of Blockbuster Listing
articles.description: Anthropic plans to sell about 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each. The listing, expected the week of Nov. 16, could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion.

stories.title: Israel says it targeted senior Hamas commander in Gaza strike

articles.title: Israel says it targeted senior Hamas commander in Gaza strike
articles.description: The Israeli military said it struck a senior member of Hamas's armed wing in Gaza. Hamas sources said the commander was killed. The strike comes amid a fragile ceasefire.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO: AI company seeks valuation of more than $1 trillion

articles.title: Anthropic IPO: AI company seeks valuation of more than $1 trillion
articles.description: Anthropic set a price range of $70 to $78 a share for its initial public offering. The company is expected to price and begin trading next week on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. The deal will test investor sentiment toward artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Modine shares soar on report Samsung is in talks to acquire the company

articles.title: Modine shares soar on report Samsung is in talks to acquire the company
articles.description: Shares of Modine Manufacturing jumped more than 25% after a report that Samsung Electronics is in talks to buy the maker of thermal management equipment. The companies could reach a deal in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins Alaska governor's race

articles.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins Alaska governor's race
articles.description: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins is projected to win the race for Alaska governor, replacing a Republican. He won more than half of first-choice votes, so no ranked-choice count was needed. He will be inaugurated on Dec. 7.
